# Dali

> Production AI agents and workflow automation built inside the business tools your team already uses, from intake and operations to support and internal knowledge work.

Dali is based in Tbilisi, Georgia. Canonical site: https://daliagents.com

## Solutions

- [Conversation Control System](https://daliagents.com/solutions/conversation-control): Supervised inbox system for inbound leads and client support, with fixed lanes and human gates.
- [Ops & Knowledge System](https://daliagents.com/solutions/ops-knowledge): Turn recurring documents into actions or answer internal questions from approved sources.
- [Voice Design-Partner](https://daliagents.com/solutions/voice-agents): Prove one repeatable call flow before widening the system.
- [Rescue & Migration](https://daliagents.com/solutions/rescue-and-migration): Three fixed lanes for AI systems under pressure: agent rescue, Assistants API migration before the August 26, 2026 shutdown, and vibe-code hardening.
